findings.comment: Existing overhead electric facilities shown on Sheet 21 but completeness cannot be verified. Plan shows existing OHE line along western boundary and poles, but does not include cross-sections showing pole heights, all conductor positions, or neutral conductor identification per UCM § 1.16.0(1)(ii). No profile sheets included in electrical design.

Section view or building elevation sheets provided but electrical cross-section with pole heights and clearance envelopes not included. Sheet 21 references Sheet 19 for profile, but Sheet 19 is utility tap profile for water infrastructure, not electrical profile showing clearance envelopes.

Plans show existing utilities based on record information only. Sheet 21 utility notes state location is based on record information and contractor must verify actual locations via Texas 811. No field survey or accuracy certification provided for existing electric facilities in/adjacent to construction area.

Proposed electric infrastructure shown (transformer pads, meters, pull boxes) but critical details missing: service voltage, electrical load, number of service points, and point of connection to existing AE facilities not identified on plans.

Point of connection to existing AE facilities not clearly identified on plans. Sheet 21 shows underground electric line entering site from western boundary but the specific connection point to existing infrastructure is not labeled or dimensioned.

Proposed electrical route from existing AE service to proposed service not explicitly shown or described. While underground conduit routing is shown as blue lines on Sheet 21, the path lacks clear labeling indicating this is the service lateral from the point of connection, and service specifications are absent.

Electrical service not identified as primary or secondary on plans. No designation provided for whether the proposed service is a primary distribution circuit or secondary service, required per UCM § 1.3.3 for one point of service identification.

AE Standard Notes not provided on plans. Cover Sheet 1 and General Notes Sheet 3 contain Austin Energy transmission and electric notes but do not include the complete AE Standard Notes required on all electrical design submissions per UCM § 1.16.0.

Note missing stating all electric infrastructure shown including new and existing, and exceptions require AE pre-approval. Sheet 21 utility notes require contractor verification but do not include the required UCM § 1.16.0(1) note confirming completeness or exception requirements.

Electric site plan lacks full coordination with AE Design requirements. No measurements for pad-mounted transformer clearances (10-foot access door side, 5-foot minimum other sides per UCM § 1.10.4), no 20-foot x 35-foot setup area dimensions with 35-foot vertical clearance, no disconnect location, no truck access details, and no staging area notes.

Existing electric easements not shown on all required plan sheets. 5-foot electric easements are shown on Site Plan (Sheet 9) and Electrical Plan (Sheet 21) but not verified on Landscape Plan (Sheet 31), Grading Plan (Sheet 11), or Utility Tap plans where they are applicable.

Plans show both aerial (overhead lines) and underground (proposed underground conduit) electric infrastructure but easements are not distinguished as aerial vs. underground. Recorded easements (Vol. 73, Pg. 76) and proposed infrastructure require designation of easement type per UCM § 1.16.0(1)(i).

Recording information incomplete for some electric easements. While eastern and southern 5-foot easements include Vol./Pg. references (Vol. 73, Pg. 76), the western boundary easement documentation shows 'Doc#' without the actual document number.

Existing electric easements not labeled with dimensions on all sheets. While Sheet 9 shows '5' Elec. Easement', the dimension and location are not repeated on Electrical Plan (Sheet 21) or Grading Plan (Sheet 11) where infrastructure coordination is required.

No note stating absence of existing electric easements where applicable. While recorded easements exist and are shown, no explicit note on Site Plan (Sheet 9) or Electrical Plan (Sheet 21) confirms the completeness of easement depiction or whether additional easements discovered during design phase are absent.

Electric facilities not shown on all required plan sheets. Electrical Plan (Sheet 21) shows proposed infrastructure, but overhead electric lines (OHE) shown on Landscape (Sheet 31) and Site Plan (Sheet 9) are not shown or coordinated on Grading Plan (Sheet 11) or Storm Drain Plan (Sheet 12). Transformers and meters shown on Sheet 21 but not reflected on other coordination sheets.

Tree locations and electric infrastructure locations not coordinated across plan sheets. Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) shows proposed trees overlapping existing overhead electric lines (OHE) along western boundary, but no clearance dimensions, species selection restrictions, or coordination notes are provided per UCM § 1.10.3 clearance requirements (15-foot radius from distribution conductors).

Profile plans provided (Sheets 19, 20) but do not include existing utility poles with cross arms or clearance envelopes. Sheets 19-20 show only water utility profiles, not electrical utility infrastructure profiles showing pole dimensions and NESC clearances.

Cannot verify compliance with transformer staging area clearances. Sheet 21 shows two transformer pad locations but does not dimension the required 20-foot x 35-foot setup area or 35-foot vertical clearance. Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) does not show these clearance zones, preventing verification that landscaping avoids the required staging area.

Electric design not on separate sheet from other utilities and not clearly labeled 'Electric Only'. Sheet 21 shows electrical infrastructure but may include references to other utilities (water, wastewater per utility notes). Electric facilities should be shown on a dedicated electric-only sheet clearly labeled per AE design criteria.

Plans do not demonstrate that development preserves AE personnel access. No truck access paths (12-foot width, 16-foot vertical clearance) or setup areas (20-foot x 35-foot with 35-foot vertical clearance) are dimensioned on plans. No accessibility route dimensions provided for existing or proposed transformer locations.

Projected electrical load not shown on plans. Sheet 21 shows proposed transformer pads and meters but does not identify the electrical load, service voltage, amperage requirements, or transformer capacity required to serve the 39-unit residential development.

Meter location compliance cannot be verified. Sheet 21 shows electrical meters on building walls but provides no architectural elevations showing exact meter heights, proximity to building overhangs (>72 inches?), gas meters (3-foot separation?), or flood elevation verification (minimum 1 foot above 100-year floodplain). Project is in Zone X (outside floodplain) but meter details remain unverified.

Cannot verify whether subdivision is within 200 feet of existing AE infrastructure without measuring from the site boundaries. Existing overhead electric lines visible along western boundary (shown on Sheet 21) suggest proximity trigger may apply, but no notation on plans states whether AE approval has been obtained or distance measurement performed per LDC § 25-4-200(B).
